messages.text: Rig is ready: GIMX reachable and a live video signal present. 1 caveat(s) recorded.
Scenario 'Entry point for Game Activity' validated with 6 success criteria.
Executed 33/40 steps; 30 dispatched; screen changed at least once: True. ABORTED: Blind tapping prevented: Console is on the Xbox Dashboard Home ('sponsored') instead of the running game.

FAIL: The run successfully navigated to Game Activity, Achievements, and Stats pages with proper game name and content visible. However, the final criterion—returning to the dashboard—was not met. After pressing B from the official club page (step 31), the console returned to the Xbox Dashboard Home (showing "SPONSORED" content and game tiles), not to the Game Activity page. The run then aborted with "Blind tapping prevented" because the executor detected the console was on the dashboard rather than in a game context. The scenario requires returning to the dashboard at the end, but the evidence shows the run ended prematurely without completing the full journey back through Game Activity to the dashboard as specified in the success criteria.

Root cause (product_defect, confidence 75%): The console navigated directly from the official club page to the Xbox Dashboard Home instead of returning to Game Activity first, causing the test to abort when the executor detected an unexpected state. The rig was healthy and responsive throughout; the console received and acted on all inputs correctly. This is a navigation sequence issue in the console's UI behavior, not a rig failure. | lesson L002-20261015114415 recorded (seen 1x)
